title: Team tool spring round
about: Five open items for the next round of the team tool. You say yes, no or later for each, then the agent builds.

unit.explain: A build night is about three hours of work with an agent.

items.title: Keep important cards at the top
items.about: You right-click a card and pick Pin. It stays in its own block at the top until you unpin it.
items.familiar: Your most used card slides down as soon as others wait longer.
items.why: The card you open most would always be in the same place.
items.risk: Pin too much and the top is a long list again.
items.conflict: In February you said the longest waiting card goes first.
items.proposalWhy: Cheap and it hits the card you open most.
items.counter: If something sticks at the top, you look less at the questions below it.
captions: A tidy board in the morning.
The key card slides to the bottom.
The pin menu as it looks today.

items.title: Find a card by name
items.about: A search field above the cards filters them as you type, also in v2 names.
items.proposalWhy: With 31 cards and 41 % of them idle, scrolling takes too long.
items.counter: Most days there are fewer than 10 cards.
captions: Two letters and it is there.
A draft of the search field.

items.title: Archive finished cards by themselves
items.about: Cards that are done for a week move to the archive on their own.
items.proposalWhy: You like to see what is done.
items.counter: The board would stay short without any work.

items.title: A separate app for the phone
items.about: The board as its own phone app with notifications.
items.counter: You are away from the desk a lot.

items.title: Where the cards are stored
items.about: The cards live either on this computer or in a cloud folder.
items.proposalWhy: Then the phone can read them later.
items.counter: A cloud folder can sync late.
